summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) hidden trial banner and (2) replacement of all native <input type='date'> with the Shadcn Calendar+Popover DatePicker. Three Playwright sessions run against the public URL with full onboarding (login testuser@test.com -> privacy waiver -> partner consent -> partner setup). All 4 DatePicker locations verified live (partner setup, log period, phase predictor, AND the deny-extension picker which I managed to trigger by logging a short cycle). 0 console errors, 0 page errors across all runs.
test_report_links: Playwright scripts executed inline via browser automation tool (frontend-only scope; no pytest files created)
critical_code_review_comments: date-picker.jsx classNames keys match react-day-picker v8.10.1 (installed version) - verified visually: dark slate popover, cyan selected day, today highlighted, disabled future days at 50% opacity.

DatePicker parses/serializes YYYY-MM-DD manually (parseLocal/toDateStr) so no timezone off-by-one - confirmed end-to-end: picking Aug 5 logged '8/5/2026' in Recent Cycles; picking Aug 15 in Predictor produced 'Saturday, August 15, 2026'.

Trial banner code retained but gated with `false && planType === 'trial'` (Dashboard.jsx:1002) and a second `false && (...)` at line 1550 - dead-code gating is intentional per request; consider a named feature flag constant instead of literal `false` for readability.
Dashboard.jsx still >700 lines (~1850) - split into modules (repeat finding from iteration 24).
seed_data_creation: Local-only (localStorage) partner profile 'TEST_Ava' created in each headless session; one cycle logged (Aug 5, 2026) via the Log Period form and one deny-extension reset (Aug 12, 2026). Nothing persisted server-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding steps unchanged from iteration 24. All 4 DatePickers are now BUTTON triggers with testids: cycle-start-date-input, log-period-date-input, prediction-date-input, deny-date-input. In Playwright, open with a normal click then select a day via `button[name='day']:not([disabled])` filtered by text (react-day-picker v8 renders day cells as button[name=day]). Tip to trigger the cycle-extension alert (which reveals deny-date-input): after partner setup with start date = 10th of the month, open History and log a period for the 5th - the EWMA average drops to ~5 days so the 'Cycle Extended' card with 'No, it already started - enter date' appears immediately. Dashboard tabs are: AI Wingman, Partner Profile, Coaching Manual (AI chat uses an input, not a textarea).
rca_of_the_issue: Verified results: (1) Login -> /app OK. (2) data-testid=trial-banner count = 0 on Dashboard; input[type=date] count = 0 on Dashboard and Phase Predictor (also 0 after opening every dialog/alert form). (3) cycle-start-date-input is BUTTON; calendar popover opens (1 grid), selecting day 10 shows 'Aug 10, 2026', partner profile created successfully. (4) log-period-date-input is BUTTON; 42 day buttons rendered, 6 future days disabled (max=today enforced); selecting 'Aug 5, 2026' + Log Period shows toast 'Period logged!' and adds '8/5/2026 - 5 days' to Recent Cycles. (5) prediction-date-input is BUTTON; selecting 15 shows 'Aug 15, 2026' and prediction renders 'According to her current 28-day average cycle, on Saturday, August 15, 2026 she'll be in the Follicular phase - Day 6' plus TRANSLATION planning tip; Clear button appears. (6) deny-date-input is BUTTON with popover, 6 disabled future days, selecting 'Aug 12, 2026' + 'Set as Day 1' shows toast 'Cycle reset to new Day 1!' and the phase card recalculates. (7) MoodMap phase wheel renders with all 5 segments (Menstrual 1-5, Follicular 6-13, Ovulation 14-16, Luteal 17-23, PMS 24-28, active highlighted); Coaching Manual tab loads accordions; AI Wingman tab shows 'Your AI Wingman' chat area with prompt text and message input. 0 error elements, 0 console errors, 0 page errors.
